subject: Discovery follow-up: Demo & security deep-dive for FinPath
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finpath.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: Demo & security deep-dive for FinPath

Hi Emily —

Great speaking with you and Liam earlier. Quick recap from our call: FinPath is evaluating an LLM inference platform for core customer-facing workflows with emphasis on predictable latency, auditability, and data residency. You mentioned a product demo for the broader platform + a technical/security deep-dive for your architects and InfoSec.

Next steps I propose:
- 30-minute product demo (overview + driveable ROI examples)
- 45-minute technical deep-dive (architecture, security controls, data residency options)

Available windows I have next week:
- Tue 2026-07-21: 09:00–11:30 PT (best slot: 10:00 PT)
- Wed 2026-07-22: 08:30–12:00 PT (best slot: 09:00 PT)

Can you confirm which of those works for your team? If helpful, please loop in the folks from security/procurement so we can align agendas. I attached a mutual action plan to kick off scheduling and deliverables.

I'll also loop in our solutions engineer (Dev Patel) and our security lead (Irene Choi) once we lock times.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — great write-up.

Liam (procurement) and I reviewed the windows. We'll want both sessions: a product demo for the PM/engineering stakeholders and a separate technical/security session for InfoSec/Platform. I'm looping in Sana (security) and Liam on this thread.

Proposed: Tue 2026-07-21 at 10:00 PT for the 30m demo.
Would you also be able to run the deeper technical/security session on Wed 2026-07-22 in the morning? Sana — can you confirm availability and any specific artifacts you'd like ahead of time (SOC 2, data flow diagrams, encryption details)?

Emily Zhang
Head of Platform Integrations | FinPath
emily.zhang@finpath.com | (212) 555-4466

Hi all — thanks for looping me in. I can make the morning of Wed 2026-07-22, 09:00 PT works best for me.

For the tech/security deep-dive, please share the following ahead of time if possible:
- SOC 2 Type II report or letter of attestation
- Data flow diagram showing where customer data is hosted/processed
- Encryption at rest / in transit details and KMS options
- Retention and deletion policies + audit logging examples

If you can attach a short security pack, that will help speed internal approvals.

Thanks,
Sana Mirza
Senior InfoSec Manager | FinPath
sana.mirza@finpath.com

- Tue 2026-07-21, 10:00–10:30 PT: Product demo (Zoom link + calendar invite to follow)
- Wed 2026-07-22, 09:00–09:45 PT: Technical & security deep-dive (Irene will lead security sections; Dev will cover architecture/perf)
